channel.title: Dispatches from Gaza by The Blue Fern Co.
channel.description: Text-first Gaza audio briefing transcripts derived from source-backed daily editions.
channel.itunes:author: The Blue Fern Co.
channel.itunes:summary: Text-first Gaza audio briefing transcripts derived from source-backed daily editions.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 24, 2026
item.description: Four Palestinians killed as Israeli settlers raid occupied West Bank town. One Israeli was also killed near town of Tal in Nablus, according to Israel's Magen David Adom rescue services. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 23, 2026
item.description: Palestine Action barrister's prosecution criticised as 'chilling'. CBA chair says contempt charge over closing speech by Rajiv Menon KC has left lawyers fearful of doing their job. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 21, 2026
item.description: Gaza celebrates World Cup victory of Spanish team they took into their hearts. People gather at cafes and outdoor screenings to support team after Spain's backing for Palestinian rights. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 20, 2026
item.description: Occupied West Bank World Cup screening halted for funeral. A screening of the FIFA World Cup final in Ramallah was halted following news that two Palestinians were killed. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 19, 2026
item.description: From settlements to blocked recovery: Israeli strategy taking shape in Gaza. Setting up illegal settlements, erasing cities and obstructing aid serve goal of forcing Palestinians out, analysts say. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 18, 2026
item.description: Israeli ministers announce plans for new illegal settlements in Gaza and West Bank. Defence minister seeks three 'Nahal' outposts in Gaza as top commander says. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 17, 2026
item.description: Trump's Board of Peace drops full Gaza recovery plan in favour of tiny pilot scheme. Revised plan aims to 'keep something going' amid fears Netanyahu may gamble on new all-out offensive before Israeli elections. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 16, 2026
item.description: Palestinians fight fires after settler attacks in the occupied West Bank. Overnight Israeli settler attacks set farmlands ablaze in Masafer Yatta and burned vehicles near Tulkarem. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 15, 2026
item.description: Arrest of American who has given $1m in aid to Palestine prompts fears of 'growing repression from Trump'. Extradition request for James 'Fergie' Chambers sparks concerns that US government is conflating humanitarian aid with terrorism. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 13, 2026
item.description: Sheikh Hamad: The Arab leader who broke Israel's siege on Gaza. A look at Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani's enduring legacy of solidarity and support for the Palestinian people. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 11, 2026
item.description: Power cuts plunge Gaza hospitals into darkness as Israel's attacks persist. Gaza is suffering from an energy crisis, affecting hospitals struggling to treat patients amid Israeli bombing. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 10, 2026
item.description: IDF accused of 'field execution' of Palestinian driver bringing aid into Gaza. Local truckers' association says it may suspend operations, after several eyewitnesses decried Ahmad Esleem's murder. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 8, 2026
item.description: Gaza aid worker killed minutes before World Cup screening he organised. Mohamed al-Wahidi died when a missile struck his taxi shortly before Egypt played Argentina in their last 16 match. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 6, 2026
item.description: Israeli command system identified 850,000 targets in Gaza and Lebanon wars, says supplier. Elbit Systems supplied Tzayad digital army programme to map people, vehicles and other objects in real time. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 5, 2026
item.description: Jailed Gaza hospital chief in life-threatening condition, rights group says. Elyas Abu Safia says his father Hussam can barely breathe or speak after more than 555 days in Israeli prison. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 4, 2026
item.description: At least 7 Palestinians killed by Israeli forces over past 48 hours in Gaza. A further nine bodies were recovered from under the rubble, according to Gaza's Ministry of Health. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 3, 2026
item.description: A heatwave in a miserable tent in Gaza: 'I dream of a glass of cold water'. This was reported by EL PAIS English. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 2, 2026
item.description: 'Two weeks after her death I got a call': Gaza patients face agonising delays for evacuation. An estimated 300 Palestinians referred for treatment abroad have died since the ceasefire began, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for July 1, 2026
item.description: Expansion of areas under Israeli control in Gaza endangers civilians and relief efforts. The United Nations and NGOs warn that the continued expansion of areas under Israeli control in Gaza is intensifying risks to civilians and further constraining humanitarian efforts. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 30, 2026
item.description: Video: At least two killed and hundreds displaced in Israeli attack on Gaza. An Israeli attack on the al-Mawasi camp in Khan Younis has killed several people, including a mother and her child. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 29, 2026
item.description: Israeli attack in Gaza kills three, including a child. The strike in Deir el-Balah is the latest Israeli attack amid ongoing 'ceasefire' violations. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 28, 2026
item.description: Israel kills three Palestinians in Gaza attacks. Israeli attacks have killed at least three Palestinians in the Gaza Strip, including two people targeted by a drone in the north of the enclave. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 27, 2026
item.description: Israeli drone attack kills young girl in Gaza safe zone. Israeli drones struck tents in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, killing two Palestinians and wounding several others. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 26, 2026
item.description: Israeli forces shoot and kill Palestinians in occupied West Bank, Gaza. Al Jazeera reported that Israeli forces shot and killed Palestinians in incidents involving the occupied West Bank and Gaza. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 24, 2026
item.description: Israel continues to commit genocide by targeting children in Gaza, UN inquiry finds | First Thing. Palestinian children 'deliberately targeted and killed', report's chair says. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 22, 2026
item.description: What the World Cup looks like from Gaza. Gaza's footballers train on broken pitches with no shoes. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 21, 2026
item.description: 'Kind, principled': Colleagues remember Gaza journalist killed by Israel. Ahmed Wishah is the 12th Al Jazeera journalist killed by Israel in Gaza since October 2023. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 20, 2026
item.description: Parents and two daughters killed in Israeli strike in Gaza.. Israel has repeatedly violated the October ceasefire brokered by the US. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 19, 2026
item.description: Some UN Security Council members warn Gaza humanitarian crisis worsening despite ceasefire.. Pakistan, China, UK and Russia call for unrestricted aid access as US blames Hamas for ongoing suffering in enclave. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 18, 2026
item.description: Israel has killed more than 1,000 people in Gaza since ceasefire. The number of Palestinians killed by Israel since an October 2025 so-called 'truce' brokered by US President Donald Trump was 1,008, the health ministry said. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 17, 2026
item.description: Israeli drone strike kills 2 beachgoers, wounds 6 in southern Gaza. Attack on crowded beachfront in Khan Younis targets civilians seeking relief from summer heat, as. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 16, 2026
item.description: Israel kills 2 Palestinians in strike on civilians in central Gaza. Israeli drone targets gathering north of Nuseirat refugee camp in new violation of ceasefire in place since October 2025. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 15, 2026
item.description: Palestinian death toll in Gaza tops 73,000, officials say, as Israel strikes despite ceasefire. Israel says it is targeting Hamas and other militants who pose a threat, and in response to ceasefire violations, including occasional attacks. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 14, 2026
item.description: Two killed in Israeli strike on Gaza. An Israeli strike on southern Gaza has killed two people and injured another, according to Palestinian authorities. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 13, 2026
item.description: Israeli army kills Palestinian municipality worker in central Gaza. Despite truce in effect since October 2025, Israeli army launches drone strike near Bureij refugee camp. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 12, 2026
item.description: Israel wounds 5 in shelling of Gaza school sheltering displaced Palestinians. Israeli army continues shelling and demolishing homes in eastern Gaza despite ceasefire. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 11, 2026
item.description: Amnesty accuses Israel's government of 'ethnic cleansing' of West Bank Palestinians. The London-based rights group says the Israeli government is deliberately trying to annex the Palestinian territory. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 10, 2026
item.description: Palestinians face systematic abuse by Israeli settlers and Hamas alike: Independent investigators. Palestinian civilians are trapped between escalating settler violence in the occupied West Bank and fear-based Hamas rule in the Gaza Strip, investigators appointed by the UN Human Rights Council said on Tuesday in a new report. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 9, 2026
item.description: Israel puts Palestinian doctor in solitary confinement after 17 months held without charge. Dr Hussam Abu Safiya now in cell barely big enough to sit in, says son, after UN experts demanded his release in March. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 8, 2026
item.description: Israel kills 14 people in attacks across Gaza. Israel killed at least 14 people in Gaza on Sunday in strikes across Khan Younis, Gaza City, and Deir el-Balah. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 7, 2026
item.description: 'What ceasefire?' Palestinians inspect destruction after Israeli strike. Palestinians inspect the aftermath of an Israeli strike in Khan Younis. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 6, 2026
item.description: Italy appeals for release of hunger-striking Flotilla activists. Italy urges Libya to free two detained pro-Palestinian activists as a Gaza aid convoy hunger strike enters its fifth day. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 5, 2026
item.description: Israel Supreme Court strikes down ban on Red Cross prison visits. Following the court's overturning of the ban, the ICRC said it is 'ready to resume' its work in visiting Palestinian prisoners in held in Israeli detention. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 4, 2026
item.description: Gaza's public servants systematically targeted in Israeli strikes. Months since Gaza's nominal ceasefire began, Palestinians continue to be killed and maimed in drone and airstrikes, including the enclave's police force which is crucial to peace and reconstruction efforts, the UN human rights office (OHCHR) said on Wednesday. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 3, 2026
item.description: Zak Khan on Israeli detention after Gaza aid mission. The New Arab Meets: Zak Khan to speak more on the Gaza flotilla, his abuse in Israeli detention, and running as a Green Party candidate in the UK. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 2, 2026
item.description: 3 Gazans killed by Israeli fire in latest ceasefire violations. Israeli army continues its daily violations of ceasefire in Palestinian enclave. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for June 1, 2026
item.description: Palestinian killed in Israeli drone strike in Gaza despite ceasefire. Israel has killed 932, injured 2,859 in Gaza since ceasefire, according to local authorities. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.

item.title: Gaza Briefing for May 31, 2026
item.description: Israeli forces kill Palestinian who allegedly carried out car-ramming attack in occupied West Bank. Suspected attacker shot dead at scene, Israeli media reports. Transcript and source links are available from The Blue Fern Co.
